critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 512 lines and starting to mix concerns (WordPress precheck endpoints + Opportunity Engine APIs + SSR routes). Recommend extracting routes_opportunities.py and routes_wp_precheck.py for maintainability before Fase 3.

catalog_data.py facet_counts() iterates the full OPPORTUNITIES list 4 times × (products+assets+geo+procedures+phases+possessions) per request. Currently cheap (13 items) but will become O(N * M) hot when catalogue grows; consider precomputing per-facet buckets or caching.
documentation_for() is a pure function of (product, procedure, phase) → cacheable via functools.lru_cache keyed on those three fields.

In detalle.html the 'Documentación concursal' group is present in HTML but appears collapsed by default — Playwright innerText missed it. Not a bug but consider expanding the pending-source doc-group by default so users immediately see the transparency notice.

The regression check 'no public VIP text' has to strip <style>/<script> because there's still a CSS comment '/* granular lock (non-VIP acuerdos deep-link) */' inside base.html/detalle.html — internal only, but recommend renaming comments to 'non-Premium' to keep the codebase aligned with public terminology.
